args.title: Fix issue 4409 in README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

The 'Running locally' steps in README.md mention starting a MinIO container but do not mention the need to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO. Adding a line about setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket would clarify setup and prevent the error.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Running locally' steps in README.md mention starting a MinIO container but do not mention the need to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO. Adding a line about setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket would clarify setup and prevent the error.
